errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states the sectors' patterns and representation, such as claiming 'Европалети' has a horizontal line pattern when it has a solid pattern.
Description states 'Европалети' is 23.61% when it actually corresponds to the second sector.
Incorrectly assigns 24.67% to 'Кашони' while it actually corresponds to 'Други палети'.
The description does not sufficiently convey that the pie chart represents the structure of warehouse turnover by category.
The description fails to mention that the sectors are visually distinct and presents different patterns and colors.
